protocol: Within-corpus development. Full SRL conditions run on all 2,375 original claims. The two model conditions use the same 48 inputs: 24 known development-pilot cases and 24 additional IDs sampled uniformly before generation. The same assistant reviews the 24 random cases under all conditions. The SRL graph was frozen before that review; the restricted edit interface followed a separate 12-output regeneration pilot that changed correct roles. This is not human gold or a source-disjoint generalization study. Compilation counts do not establish semantic faithfulness.
